QueryString.value: SELECT task.Project as Project, task.Package as Package, task.Version as Version, task.Type as Type, task.Name as Name, task.Page as Page, task.TaskPackage as TaskPackage, task.TaskVersion as TaskVersion, task.TaskNrInputs as TaskNrInputs, task.TaskNrOutputs as TaskNrOutputs, codetask.TaskId, codetask.LoC as LinesOfCode, codetask.NrServiceCalls, codetask.MesEntities, codetask.Complexity FROM ( -- CodeTask's own Resource_Name is a generic literal ("codeExecution"), not a unique -- identity — the real per-entity key is the TaskId parameter, so dedup on that instead. SELECT Project, Package, Version, TaskId, argMax(LoC, _created_at) AS LoC, argMax(NrServiceCalls, _created_at) AS NrServiceCalls, argMax(MesEntities, _created_at) AS MesEntities, argMax(Complexity, _created_at) AS Complexity FROM ( SELECT Enterprise_Name AS Project, Site_Name AS Package, Facility_Name AS Version, Area_Name AS Type, _created_at, Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'TaskId')][1] AS TaskId, Parameters_NumericValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'LoC')][1] AS LoC, Parameters_NumericValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'Nr of Service Calls')][1] AS NrServiceCalls, Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'MES Entities Mentioned')][1] AS MesEntities, Parameters_NumericValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'Complexity')][1] AS Complexity FROM PostTelemetry WHERE Type = 'CodeTask' ) GROUP BY Project, Package, Version, TaskId ) AS codetask LEFT JOIN ( -- Like CodeTask, Task's own Resource_Name is frequently a generic orchestration-node -- label ("workflow", "subWorkflowStart", "codeExecution"...), shared by many distinct -- TaskId instances in the same package — so this join also keys on TaskId, not Name. SELECT Project, Package, Version, TaskId, argMax(Type, _created_at) AS Type, argMax(Name, _created_at) AS Name, argMax(Page, _created_at) AS Page, argMax(TaskPackage, _created_at) AS TaskPackage, argMax(TaskVersion, _created_at) AS TaskVersion, argMax(TaskNrInputs, _created_at) AS TaskNrInputs, argMax(TaskNrOutputs, _created_at) AS TaskNrOutputs FROM ( SELECT Enterprise_Name AS Project, Site_Name AS Package, Facility_Name AS Version, Area_Name AS Type, Resource_Name AS Name, _created_at, Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'Page')][1] AS Page, Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'TaskId')][1] AS TaskId, Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'Package')][1] AS TaskPackage, Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'Version')][1] AS TaskVersion, Parameters_NumericValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'Nr. of Inputs')][1] AS TaskNrInputs, Parameters_NumericValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'Nr. of Outputs')][1] AS TaskNrOutputs FROM PostTelemetry WHERE Type = 'Task' ) GROUP BY Project, Package, Version, TaskId ) AS task USING (Project, Package, Version, TaskId)
